title: NNQA: Neural-Native Quantum Arithmetic for End-to-End Polynomial Synthesis
summary: Hybrid classical quantum learning is often bottlenecked by communication overhead and approximation error from generic variational ansatzes. In this study, we introduce Neural Native Quantum Arithmetic (NNQA), which compiles classically learned nonlinear representations into precise quantum arithmetic composed of native unitary blocks.
